title: 第5章 一阶灵魂碎片第6章 变异灵茶
content_zh:
“傍上富婆了？不可能啊，第一次降临都出生在新手据点。”
发小赵永强，身体健壮，运动天赋拉满。
“不是，南哥，我这次真的不得了，天胡开局，一降临就碰上四个亚洲面孔的伙伴，还都是漂亮妹子，个个都争着认我做大哥，甩都甩不开，哥也是被迫无奈，只好带她们飞……现在哥已经学习了基础功法【猛虎七式】和【基础拳法】，体质力量都高达15点，可以单挑骷髅怪了，帅不帅？”
第一天就能成长到单挑骷髅怪，这确实是天选之子的气运。
“哟，可以啊，小强，你这开局都差点赶上我们班的坚哥了。”
略带嘲讽的声音从隔壁五班传来，整个机房像一个大网吧，一排排，站起来说话周围都能听见。
方南山他们是六班，跟五班隔了一条过道。
“刘志坚？你也学习功法了？”
赵永强诧异的看向五班，只见四五个人簇拥着一名高大的男生，神情略带骄傲。
方南山对此人也熟悉，以前初中的时候就经常跟赵永强较劲，篮球场上永远都是对手，但这世界已经不兴打篮球了，开始拼武技，斗得更加起劲。
“运气不错，六个蓝星人，三个异星人，都愿意听我指挥，现在已经学习三门基础技法，周围十八只骷髅怪全部清理……”刘志坚淡淡的说道。
周围同学顿时一片哗然，这才叫真正的天胡，绝对是完美开局的典范。
“起步确实不错，但小小领先算不得什么，后续发展我绝不会输给你，下面看谁先冲到十级，学习进阶功法！”赵永强不服气的回应。
“一步先，步步先，小强啊，你永远也追不上哥的步伐了，你已经不配成为我的对手！”
“刘志坚，别嚣张，我一定会赶超你的。”
每一年每个班都有个别幸运儿，开局巨大优势，但后面发展却不尽如人意，也有人步步领先，一飞冲天，同时更不乏后继发力，后来居上者。
仙道漫漫，谁也不知道前面有什么境遇等着你。
方南山没有参与这些一时意气的争吵，因为在他眼里，在座的各位，都是乐色。
离开机房，回到班级中，赵永强还有些愤愤不平，耿耿于怀。
“居然让刘志坚那小垃圾装逼成功了，好气啊！”

方南山安慰他，“强哥你也不差，带四个妹子，不比他埋头打骷髅快乐得多？”
“倒也是，可能也是这个原因，导致我速度慢了……不行，我不能沉迷在女色中，我要奋起努力，绝不能让大头坚先一步晋阶。”
阿强斗志满满的紧握双拳，给自己打气，“对了，南哥，你开局怎样？”
“很好啊，充满了激情和悬念，并且我一个人笑到了最后……”
方南山简单的描述一下自己的经历，变异天赋的能力有所保留。
周围同学都听得一阵阵惊呼，“看来我们班最惨的还是你，表面上你还活着，其实你已经死了。”
“只要还活着，就有转机，说不定明天我登陆上去，突然有路过的土着仙人顺手帮我一下，这不就一飞冲天了？”方南山耸耸肩，表示无所谓，绝处逢生的奇遇，不都是这样来的吗。
content_en:
"Fucking a rich woman? Impossible. He was born in the novice stronghold for the first time."
Zhao Yongqiang is a young boy with a strong body and full athletic talent.
"No, Brother Nan, I really did something extraordinary this time. When Tianhu started, I met four partners with Asian faces as soon as I arrived. They were all beautiful girls. They all wanted to recognize me as their big brother and couldn't get rid of them. I was forced to have no choice but to take them flying... Now that I have learned the basic skills [Seven Tiger Styles] and [Basic Boxing], my physical strength is as high as 15 points. I can challenge the skeleton monster alone. Isn't he handsome?"
Being able to grow up to fight a skeleton monster on the first day is indeed the luck of the chosen one.
"Oh, yes, Xiaoqiang, you almost caught up with Brother Jian in our class at this start."
A slightly sarcastic voice came from Class 5 next door. The entire computer room was like a big Internet cafe, with rows of people standing up and talking, which could be heard all around.
Fang Nanshan and the others were in Class 6, separated by an aisle from Class 5.
"Liu Zhijian? Have you learned the exercises too?"
Zhao Yongqiang looked at Class 5 in surprise and saw four or five people surrounding a tall boy with a slightly proud expression.
Fang Nanshan is also familiar with this person. He used to compete with Zhao Yongqiang when he was in junior high school. They were always opponents on the basketball court. However, the world is no longer interested in playing basketball. He started to compete with martial arts and fought more energetically.
"I'm lucky. Six Blue Stars and three aliens are all willing to listen to my command. Now I have learned three basic techniques and cleared all the eighteen skeleton monsters around..." Liu Zhijian said calmly.
The surrounding students were in an uproar. This was the real Tianhu, and he was definitely a model of a perfect start.
"The start is indeed good, but a small lead is nothing. I will never lose to you in the subsequent development. Let's see who reaches level ten first and learns advanced skills!" Zhao Yongqiang responded unconvinced.
"One step first, one step at a time, Xiaoqiang, you will never be able to catch up with me. You are no longer worthy of being my opponent!"
"Liu Zhijian, don't be arrogant, I will definitely catch up with you."
Every year, there are some lucky people in every class who have a huge advantage at the beginning, but their subsequent development is not satisfactory. There are also some people who take the lead step by step and soar into the sky. At the same time, there are also many people who follow up and catch up from behind.
The road to immortality is long, and no one knows what situations are waiting for you ahead.
Fang Nanshan did not participate in these temporary quarrels, because in his eyes, everyone here was happy.
After leaving the computer room and returning to the class, Zhao Yongqiang was still a little aggrieved and resentful.
"I actually let that little trash like Liu Zhijian succeed in showing off. I'm so angry!"
Fang Nanshan comforted him, "Brother Qiang, you're not bad either. Taking care of four girls wouldn't be much more enjoyable than him beating skeletons?"
"Indeed, it may be this reason that caused me to be slow... No, I can't indulge in women's lust. I have to work hard and never let Da Toujian advance to the next level."
Aqiang clenched his fists full of fighting spirit and encouraged himself, "By the way, Brother Nan, how do you start?"
"It was very good, full of passion and suspense, and I laughed to the end alone..."
Fang Nanshan briefly described his experience and reserved his ability to mutate his talent.
The students around me heard exclaiming, "It seems that you are the worst offender in our class. On the surface, you are still alive, but in fact, you are already dead."
"As long as you're alive, there will be an opportunity. Maybe tomorrow I will land, and suddenly an indigenous immortal passing by will help me. Wouldn't it be soaring into the sky?" Fang Nanshan shrugged, saying it didn't matter. Isn't this how adventures come from desperate situations?
